memo

memo lets you skip re-rendering a component when its props are unchanged. Wrap a component in memo to get a memoized version that React reuses as long as its props stay the same.

Usage

Call memo around your component definition. React compares the previous and next props shallowly during rendering. If every prop is equal, React skips re-rendering the component and reuses the last result.

const Greeting = memo(function Greeting({ name }) {
  return <h1>Hello, {name}</h1>;
});

Caveats

Memoization is a performance optimization, not a semantic guarantee. If props contain new object or function identities on every render, memo cannot help.
